name: Morocco
oneLineFragment: Walnut groves and adobe ramparts in the High Atlas.
narrativeStory:
Terraced barley fields clinging to the steep gorges of the Toubkal massif. Berber villages built of sundried mud and red river clay seem to grow directly out of the mountain bedrock.

Mule caravans climb the rocky mule passes, carrying sacks of dried figs, mint bundles, and hand-woven kilims between remote mountain valleys.
subtitle: High Atlas Massif • Imlil & Toubkal Valley
introLines: Adobe walls baked in harsh sunlight against snow peaks.
Mint tea steeped with sage in high stone passes.
Seven frames documenting ancient mountain Berber settlements.
